name: cash.waterlevels

list.description: Read latest observed buffer state for one explicit native account alias.

parameters.name: account-alias
parameters.description: Native account alias; sent in aliasNameList.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Exact local currency filter; repeated values form a union.

summary: Native account buffer and waterlevel state.
purpose: Read account buffer balances by native account alias and currency without modifying configuration.
identity_description: Native account alias and currency jointly identify each buffer row.
limitations: POST /bufferReportList.json through the Liquidity PortfolioMgmt entry, scoped by aliasNameList; rowStart offsets and pageSize=1000.
Boolean success, data.data rows and fixed integer data.totalCount are required; missing identity, duplicate/conflicting rows and contradictory alias fail.
Native values, amounts, timestamps and unknown fields remain unchanged; capture time is not balance observation time.
Default list reads cache, live does not publish, refresh saves the complete account scope. Currency is a local filter and never narrows refresh publication.
